name: outofthebox
description: Out of the Box: relentless testing for AI agents. The agent keeps naming what could still break, tests each case so it fails on the old version, and stops only when a round finds nothing new. Loads as seventeen skills.

interface.shortDescription: Out of the Box: relentless testing for AI agents.
interface.longDescription: Makes the agent keep asking what could still break. The core hunt loop is always available; the dev, QA, UI, responsive, accessibility, i18n, mobile, API, data, flow, auth, AI, docs, security, infra and red and blue team skills load for the task at hand. A discipline, not a test framework.
